claims: Tommy Lloyd is the head coach of the University of Arizona men’s basketball team.
Tommy Lloyd has held the position of head coach of the University of Arizona men’s basketball team since April 14, 2021.
Tommy Lloyd spent 20 seasons as an assistant coach at Gonzaga University before joining the University of Arizona.
Tommy Lloyd was named the 2022 Pac-12 Coach of the Year in his debut season.
Tommy Lloyd was named the National Coach of the Year in his debut season.
Tommy Lloyd led the University of Arizona men’s basketball team to multiple Pac-12 titles in his first five seasons through March 2026.
Tommy Lloyd has a 146-35 record in his first five seasons through March 2026.
Tommy Lloyd is under contract through the 2028-29 season.
